dashboard.welcome_description: Basic information about your hosting account.
settings.password_description: Change the password for SSH login and for this panel - the same password works in both places.
settings.password_forced_hint: You must set a new password before you can use the rest of the panel.
settings.password_hint: Required: at least 8 characters. Recommended: at least 16 characters, upper and lower case letters, digits, special characters.
settings.error_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
cron.add_description: Schedule commands to run automatically at specific times. Use absolute paths - output is captured in your account's cron logs.
cron.template_hint: Inserts a ready-made job. WordPress/Laravel need the highlighted placeholder (domain/app folder) replaced with your own - the rest is ready to save as-is.
cron.schedule_hint: Format: minute hour day month weekday
cron.php_paths_none: No PHP CLI binaries detected on this server.
sites.manage_description: Enter the domain without "www." - choose the redirect direction separately (exception: "No redirect").
sites.domain_hint: Without "www." - with the "No redirect" option you can also enter the full www. domain (e.g. www.example.com) as a single, standalone domain.
sites.mail_dns_warning: Note: first add a mail DNS record.
sites.mail_dns_example_caption: Example (Cloudflare) - replace the IP with your server's address. Proxy status must stay "DNS only" (grey cloud, OFF):
sites.template_reverseproxy_hint: Run your app locally on 127.0.0.1:PORT, then enter that port above (Python: use the Python tab - venv, framework and Start handle this automatically; Node: npm start on a port, keep it alive yourself).
sites.template_php_pool_hint: PHP-FPM pool size (number of worker processes) is sized automatically from your package's RAM limit.
sites.wp_install_hint: Once you pick a language, WordPress is downloaded from wordpress.org and extracted into public/ - the index.php/info.php placeholder is NOT created in that case.
sites.limit_reached: You have reached the site limit from your package ({limit}).
sites.php_restart_confirm: Restart PHP-FPM worker processes for this version? This reloads ALL sites on the same PHP version (not just this one), gracefully - no active connections are dropped.
sites.confirm_delete: Delete site {domain}? The Caddy config AND ALL FILES under ~/domains/{domain} will be PERMANENTLY deleted. This cannot be undone.
sites.empty: You don't have any site yet.
sites.config_edit_hint: Below is the full, raw Caddy config for this site - you can edit it by hand and add your own blocks/directives. The Compression/Security checkboxes above only insert/remove specific lines within this same content. Click "Check" before "Activate" to validate your changes without deploying them.
mail.not_available: Mail is not installed on this server yet.
mail.disabled_hint: Mail access is disabled - contact Administration to restore it.
mail.mailbox_no_domains: You don't have any domain with active mail yet - enable mail handling when adding a site (Sites -> Add site).
mail.mailbox_manage_description: Create a new mailbox for one of your domains with active mail.
mail.mailbox_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
mail.mailbox_confirm_remove: Delete mailbox {mailbox}? This cannot be undone.
mail.alias_manage_description: Forward mail from an address on your domain to any other email address (internal or external).
mail.dkim_manage_description: Sign outgoing mail for the selected domain - improves trust with recipients (Gmail etc.) and protects against spoofing.
mail.dkim_installed_hint: DKIM key generated and wired into OpenDKIM.
mail.dkim_not_installed_hint: No DKIM key for this domain yet - outgoing mail from it isn't signed.
mail.dkim_dns_hint: Add the record below at your DNS provider (e.g. Cloudflare):
mail.spf_dns_hint: Record at the domain root - authorizes this server's real public IP as a mail sender. Nothing to install server-side, it's just a DNS entry.
mail.dmarc_dns_hint: Starts at p=none (monitoring only, no reject/quarantine) - the recommended safe first step.
databases.manage_description: A database is always named <your_login>_<name> - one identifier for both the database and its user.
databases.no_engines: No database engine is installed on this server yet.
databases.confirm_delete: Delete this database? This cannot be undone.
databases.empty: You don't have any database yet.
redis.manage_description: A private Redis instance for your account, max 256 MB. Local-only (no network access) - password is optional.
redis.not_available: Redis is not installed on this server yet.
redis.contact_admin_hint: To increase the Redis RAM limit, contact your Administrator.
python.manage_description: Each app gets its own independent venv and process - different apps can use different package versions without conflicting.
python.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dash - no spaces (e.g. my-shop).
python.no_versions_hint: No Python version was detected on this server - contact your Administrator.
python.empty_apps: You don't have any Python apps yet.
python.confirm_delete_app: Delete the app {slug}? The venv AND ALL PROJECT FILES (~/apps/{slug}) will be PERMANENTLY deleted. This cannot be undone.
python.reverseproxy_hint: To expose the running app under a domain, add a site using the Reverse Proxy template and point it at its port.
python.django_dev_hint: The Django starter has DEBUG=True and ALLOWED_HOSTS=['*'] - these are development-only shortcuts, harden them manually over SSH before going to production.
python.help_title: How to install / how to use
python.help_django: On creation the panel installs Django + gunicorn and scaffolds a starter project (cdapp) in ~/apps/<name>/app. Click Start - the panel runs gunicorn on the chosen port as a systemd service and keeps it running. Edit the code over SSH/SFTP in ~/apps/<name>/app, then click Start again to restart the service after changes.
python.help_flask: On creation the panel installs Flask + gunicorn and scaffolds a minimal ~/apps/<name>/app/app.py. Click Start - the panel runs gunicorn on the chosen port as a systemd service. Edit app.py over SSH/SFTP, then click Start again after changes.
python.help_fastapi: On creation the panel installs FastAPI + uvicorn and scaffolds a minimal ~/apps/<name>/app/main.py. Click Start - the panel runs uvicorn on the chosen port as a systemd service. Edit main.py over SSH/SFTP, then click Start again after changes.
python.help_manual: The panel only creates a bare venv (~/apps/<name>/venv, no packages) and an empty ~/apps/<name>/app folder for your code - no scaffold, no automatic startup. Log in over SSH, activate the venv (source ~/apps/<name>/venv/bin/activate), install whatever you need (pip install ...) and run the app yourself (your own systemd service, nohup, screen/tmux) on the port shown in the table. The Start/Stop/Logs buttons aren't available here - the panel doesn't supervise this process.
node.manage_description: Each app gets its own directory and node_modules - different apps can use different package versions without conflicting.
node.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dash - no spaces (e.g. my-shop).
node.no_versions_hint: No Node version was detected on this server - contact your Administrator.
node.empty_apps: You don't have any Node apps yet.
node.confirm_delete_app: Delete the app {slug}? The app directory AND ALL PROJECT FILES (~/node-apps/{slug}) will be PERMANENTLY deleted. This cannot be undone.
node.reverseproxy_hint: To expose the running app under a domain, add a site using the Reverse Proxy template and point it at its port.
node.help_title: How to install / how to use
node.help_express: On creation the panel installs Express and scaffolds a minimal ~/node-apps/<name>/index.js. Click Start - the panel runs `node index.js` on the chosen port (passed as the PORT env var) as a systemd service and keeps it running. Edit index.js over SSH/SFTP, then click Start again to restart the service after changes.
node.help_fastify: On creation the panel installs Fastify and scaffolds a minimal ~/node-apps/<name>/index.js. Click Start - the panel runs `node index.js` on the chosen port as a systemd service. Edit index.js over SSH/SFTP, then click Start again after changes.
node.help_koa: On creation the panel installs Koa and scaffolds a minimal ~/node-apps/<name>/index.js. Click Start - the panel runs `node index.js` on the chosen port as a systemd service. Edit index.js over SSH/SFTP, then click Start again after changes.
node.help_manual: The panel only creates a bare package.json (npm init, no packages) in ~/node-apps/<name> - no scaffold, no automatic startup. Log in over SSH, install whatever you need (npm install ...) and run the app yourself (your own systemd service, nohup, screen/tmux) on the port shown in the table. The Start/Stop/Logs buttons aren't available here - the panel doesn't supervise this process.
ssh.connection_description: Use these details in your SSH/SFTP client to connect to your website files.
ssh.keys_description: Manage SSH keys to connect without a password.
ssh.key_hint: Add the public key from your OpenSSH key pair here (for example: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub or ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub).
ssh.keys_empty: No SSH key added yet - password login is active.
backup.settings_description: Choose where your backups (restic) go and set the repository's encryption password.
backup.repo_type_local_hint: Backups go to ~/backup/repo on the same disk as your account - zero extra setup, but weaker protection (a disk failure affects both your data and its backup).
backup.jobs_description: Choose what to back up (sites and/or databases), the schedule, and how many recent snapshots to keep.
backup.no_sites_hint: No sites eligible for backup (Reverse Proxy sites have no public/ directory).
backup.keep_last_hint: Older snapshots beyond this limit are removed after every successful backup (restic forget --prune).
backup.snapshots_description: Snapshots from your restic repository. Restoring writes files to a NEW ~/backup/restore/... directory - it never overwrites your live site.
backup.confirm_restore: Restore this snapshot? Files go to a new ~/backup/restore/... directory (your live site is not overwritten).
backup.snapshots_empty: No snapshots yet - run a backup job to create the first one.
backup.snapshots_need_repo: Configure a repository in Settings first.
